The '''Pixelito Puppeteers Union''' was a [[Union (workers)|union]] of entertainers and puppeteers working in the city of [[Pixelito/Legends|Pixelito]] on [[Malastare/Legends|Malastare]].

One of their members was [[Xucaabo]], who was a well-renowned and talented puppeteer. However, he was secretly a member [[Sebolto's drug cartel]] and was deeply in debt. For these reasons, he was wanted by [[Ask Aak/Legends|Ask Aak]]. The bounty was claimed by [[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett]] in [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]].<ref name="Bounty Hunter">''[[Star Wars: Bounty Hunter]]''</ref>
